Hi all — pleased to meet you virtually. I’m Stephanie Nguyen, Contracts Lead at Redwood. Looping in a short redline checklist and the process we typically follow to keep things moving.

Redline / contracting process (typical):
- We prefer initial redlines in Word using track changes against our SOW template (attached). If you need a Google-native workflow we can export/import but Word is faster for legal review.
- We review high-priority commercial terms first (term, data usage, liability caps, termination, confidentiality). Operational items (SLA windows, metrics) flow in after commercial terms are agreed.
- We aim for a 5–7 business day legal review turnaround for an initial redline; exceptions are handled case-by-case.
- If there are SOC/Compliance questions, our SOC2_summary.pdf is attached and I can provide specific evidence links on request.

To help us scope, please confirm:
1) Procurement contact (Kelly OK?)
2) Any required contract templates or clauses from Novella (e.g., specific data residency, audit rights)
3) Decision authority for signature (name/title) and target approval week (Lauren noted week of Feb 2)

We will work from the attached Redwood_SOW_template_v3.docx. Please send redlines to me (stephanie@redwood.com) and cc Vanessa so we keep the commercial thread intact. If helpful, we can set a quick 20-minute call after you have the draft redline to walk through any high-impact items.

Thanks — I’ll tentatively plan for an initial review Jan 30 (if we receive redlines by Jan 26) but we can tighten that schedule if Novella can prioritize.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Contracts Lead, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
